content: Which line of business has the most open claims, and how many?

name: query_salesforce

content:
It's a tie: **Personal Auto** and **Commercial Property** each have **7 open claims**. Between them they make up 14 of the 26 open claims.

| Line of business | Open claims |
|---|---|
| Personal Auto | **7** |
| Commercial Property | **7** |
| General Liability | 4 |
| Homeowners | 2 |
| Commercial Auto | 2 |
| Workers Compensation | 2 |
| Renters | 2 |
